summary: Three distribution lists for sending out Network documents such as RFCs. One is for sites sending their own documents to liaisons, and the others are for the Network Information Center to reach other participants and station agents. These were postal lists with names and addresses, not email lists. It was replaced by RFC 300.

eli5.summary: This is an address book of who should get a paper copy of each new note, and which list each kind of sender should use. It is mail by post, not email.
